title: Sacramento State vs UMass read withheld
items: The Bet Better model read for Sacramento State vs UMass (75.6% Sacramento State) is withheld from the site. It conflicts with Matchday's own ratings and Sacramento State's first-season FBS results, and appears to count FCS results as FBS strength.
Withheld reads are listed with their reason in betbetter_withheld.json. A withheld game shows no model read rather than an edited number.
The model fix for teams moving from FCS to FBS is in progress.
